sloka: तथा ब्रुवति राजेन्द्रे बुधः परममद्भुतम् ।सान्त्वपूर्वमथोवाच वासस्त इह रोचताम् ।। ७.८९.१९ ॥
transliteration: tathā bruvati rājendre budhaḥ paramamadbhutam ।sāntvapūrvamathovāca vāsasta iha rocatām ।। 7.89.19 ॥

translations.english: As the king of kings spoke thus, Budha, in an exceedingly wonderful and consoling manner, then said, "May your dwelling here be pleasing to you."
